text: Planning a trip is always exciting, though it can be stressful. You have to decide on a destination, book flights, and arrange accommodation. However, the real adventure begins when you arrive. Experiencing new cultures is fascinating; simply walking down a street can feel like a lesson in history and daily life. The food is a highlight, from street markets to local restaurants, inviting you to taste unfamiliar flavours. There are often language barriers, and while pointing and gesturing can be frustrating, a smile and a few basic phrases go a long way. In the end, these challenges create the most vivid memories, making every journey uniquely unforgettable.
